subtopics.title: Two Records, One Truth — the Reconciliations

questions.question: The bank reconciliation method begins by:
options: Updating YOUR OWN books with what the statement knows and you did not — charges, debit orders, interest

questions.question: The true book balance after updates is:
options: R10 400 — 10 940 less charges 150, less debit order 450, plus interest 60

questions.question: The reconciliation statement proves agreement by:
options: Statement balance 9 800 plus outstanding deposit 3 200 less outstanding payments 2 600 landing on the same R10 400

questions.question: The creditors reconciliation lands both records on:
options: R7 550 — our 6 600 plus the unrecorded invoice 950; their 8 750 less our payment in transit 1 200

subtopics.title: Costing — Contribution and the Break-Even Line

questions.question: Contribution per unit is:
options: Selling price R25 less variable cost R10 — R15, first toward fixed costs, then to profit

questions.question: Break-even for the month is:
Profit at 620 units is:
options: R1 800 — 120 units past the line times R15, confirmed by contribution 9 300 less fixed 7 500

questions.question: If the price drops to R22, break-even:
options: Jumps to 625 units — contribution falls to R12, so 7 500 over 12

subtopics.title: Stock Systems and the Forward Documents

questions.question: Periodic cost of sales is calculated as:
options: Opening stock 12 000 plus purchases 40 000 plus carriage 3 000 less closing stock 15 000 — R40 000

questions.question: The periodic system is "blinder" because:
options: Its calculation cannot tell SOLD from STOLEN between counts

questions.question: September's budgeted collections are:
options: R27 400 — 40% of September's 30 000 plus 55% of August's 28 000

questions.question: The 5% never collected teaches that:
options: The projected income statement equals the cash budget
Budgeted receipts are always LESS than budgeted sales — planning on the full 100% plans on money that never arrives

questions.question: The question separating zero-rated from exempt is:
options: May the seller reclaim its own VAT? Zero-rated yes; exempt no
Is the seller registered for income tax?

questions.question: The VAT inside an inclusive R4 600 is:
options: R690 — fifteen percent of the total
R600 — 4 600 times 15 over 115, on an exclusive R4 000

questions.question: With output tax R9 000 and input tax R6 300, the return shows:
options: R2 700 payable to SARS — and inputs above outputs would mean a refund

questions.question: VAT collected is "trust money" because:
options: It earns interest for the vendor
It belongs to the state, collected on its behalf — spending it is spending money that was never the vendor's

questions.question: Month-end disagreement between your notebook and the bank's is:
options: NORMAL — each side knows things the other has not seen yet

questions.question: Your notebook is corrected with:
options: What the bank knew first — its fee, the debit order, the interest

questions.question: With the wholesaler, the habit in one line is:
options: Never argue balances — correct both records toward each other and pay the meeting point, R7 550

subtopics.title: The Vetkoek Line That Pays the Rent

questions.question: Vetkoek number five hundred and one matters because:
options: It is the first one working for YOU — the line is crossed and every further R15 is profit

questions.question: Selling 620 vetkoek gives profit of:
options: R1 800 — 120 past the line, each dropping its whole R15

questions.question: Cutting the price to R22 moves the line because:
options: Each vetkoek now carries only R12, so the line jumps to 625 — cheaper is not automatically smarter

subtopics.title: The Slip, the Shelf and the Month Ahead

questions.question: The VAT inside a R4 600 inclusive slip is found by:
options: Fifteen parts of one hundred and fifteen — R600, never fifteen percent of the total

questions.question: The counting way of finding cost of sales is blinder because:
options: Whatever left the shelf is assumed sold — theft hides inside the R40 000

questions.question: Planning collections at 40% now, 55% later and 5% never means:
options: Writing the month's money honestly before living it — earning and receiving are different calendars
